subtopics.title: Economic Growth — Meaning, Measurement and South Africa's Record

questions.question: Economic growth is measured as the percentage change in:
Nominal GDP rises 6% while prices rise 5%. Real growth is roughly:
Real GDP grows 1% while population grows 1,5%. Real GDP per capita:
options: Falls — output grew slower than the people sharing it

questions.question: At 5% annual growth an economy doubles in about 14 years; at 1% it takes about:

subtopics.title: Measuring Inequality — the Lorenz Curve and the Gini Coefficient

questions.question: On a Lorenz curve diagram, the straight diagonal line represents:
options: Perfect equality — every cumulative share of people holds the same share of income

questions.question: The further the Lorenz curve sags below the diagonal, the:
The Gini coefficient is calculated as:
options: The slope of the Lorenz curve
The area between the diagonal and the Lorenz curve, divided by the whole area under the diagonal

questions.question: South Africa's Gini coefficient of about 0,63 makes it:
options: The most unequal major economy in the world

subtopics.title: Redistribution — the Methods Governments Actually Use

questions.question: A tax is PROGRESSIVE when:
options: The poor pay a higher percentage of income
The rich pay a higher percentage of their income, not merely more rands

questions.question: Staple foods like maize meal are zero-rated for VAT because VAT otherwise tends to be:
options: Regressive — taking a bigger share from the poor

questions.question: Roughly how many South Africans receive a social grant each month?
Free basic water, no-fee schools and feeding schemes are classified as:
options: Redistribution in kind — services received free are income not spent

subtopics.title: Achieving Growth, the Constraints in the Way, and Standard of Living

questions.question: Which pairing correctly matches a growth method to a South African padlock on it?
options: More capital investment — blocked by too many savings
Better technology — blocked by zero-rated VAT
More exports — blocked by social grants
Reliable inputs for production — blocked by load shedding and failing freight rail

questions.question: Firms report vacancies while unemployment exceeds 30% mainly because of:
options: A mismatch between the skills produced and the skills employers need

questions.question: Which is NOT a blind spot of real GDP per capita as a living-standards measure?
options: It ignores how income is distributed
It fails to count total production of goods and services
It counts polluting production as pure gain

questions.question: The Human Development Index combines income with:

subtopics.title: The Pot and the People — Growth Done Honestly

questions.question: The 'price-tag cheat' is blocked by measuring growth:
options: In real terms — at constant prices, so only extra output counts

questions.question: The pot grows 2% but the gathering grows 3%. Each person's plate:
options: Shrinks — growth per person is negative

questions.question: Why does a growing pot matter for helping the poor?
options: It lets plates be filled without emptying others — jobs and taxes come from the pot
It removes the need for taxes

subtopics.title: The Queue of One Hundred — Seeing Inequality Without a Graph

questions.question: In the real South African queue, the coin count at person 60 has reached about:
The last 10 people in the queue hold roughly how many of the 100 coins?
A Gini coefficient of one would mean:
options: One person holds every coin — maximum possible inequality
The queue has one hundred people

questions.question: Wealth is more unequally shared than income because wealth:
options: Piles up over generations — and history blocked most South Africans from accumulating it

subtopics.title: Moving Coins Along the Queue — and Growing the Pot at the Same Time

questions.question: South Africa's top personal income tax rate on the highest income slice is:
Which move changes what people can EARN tomorrow rather than what they receive today?
options: Spending on township and rural schools to build skills
The social relief of distress grant

questions.question: Squeezing the pot too hard with taxes risks:
options: Investment leaving and jobs going with it

questions.question: The lesson's final position on growth versus redistribution is that they:
options: Are enemies — a country must choose one
Feed each other — growth funds sharing, and sharing builds the workers and buyers growth needs
